V  ·  Who it is for
11
V

Built for the whole comedy world.

New comics: learn stand-up, find the nearest open mic, apply to show runners.

Headliners and agents: tours and corporate offers in one place.

Club owners: book comics from any city.

Festivals: our AI organises shows, venues and visitors in one place.

Corporate clients: from club comics to A-list names.

Coming: the comic's app. Brainstorm material, structure sets, organise shows.

Helping amateurs turn pro, and pros keep working.

Edinburgh Fringe 2025: about 3,900 shows, 2.6M tickets.

12
VI  ·  How it earns
13
VI

How it earns

Corporate shows: a booking-service fee. Market standard 15–20%.

Ticket commissions: first partner live (Skiddle, UK).

Tour, club and festival bookings.

Advertising: our mailing lists and influencer lists.

Promoted listings, sponsors, data licensing.

Market: about $1,000–5,000 for a working comic, $50,000 and up for celebrity names (US & UK agency price guides).

Take the tour

Each step opens a real, live page.

  1. Fans: find a show

    Browse the world map, jump to any city page, or open the shows calendar. Every listing links to the organiser's own ticket page.

    Find a show

  2. Festivals: see what's on

    Festival programmes sit next to the shows and venues around them. Festival organisers can be listed too.

    See festivals

  3. Comics: claim your page

    Every comic gets a page with bio, links and upcoming shows. Claiming one is free.

    Claim your page

  4. New comics: learn stand-up

    A free, plain-English guide from writing your first jokes to your first time on stage.

    Read the Handbook

  5. Comics: find an open mic

    Open mics are where every comic starts. This guide shows how to find the ones near you.

    Find an open mic

  6. Comics: apply to show-runners

    Once you are on stage, apply directly to the people who book the shows.

    Apply for a spot

  7. Bookers & club owners: run a show

    The booker portal is where you build line-ups and invite comics to them. Venue deal terms are set in the same place.

    Open the booker portal

  8. Corporate clients: book a night

    From club comics to bigger names, tell us the date, the room and the budget. We reply by email.

    Email us

  9. What's coming: the comic's appComing

    One place for a comic's gigs, bookings and tour dates. It is not built yet; tell us what you would want in it.

    Tell us what you'd want
